'''Lesia''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. She was the great-granddaughter of [[Pars Varqom]], a retired [[Naboo Palace Guard/Legends|Palace Guard]] for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Varqom served as a [[Pearl Hat]] for 18 years under seven [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarchs]], from [[King/Legends|King]] [[Ars Veruna/Legends|Ars Veruna]] to [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Mairayni]]. His memoirs, which mentioned Lesia, were recorded in the 2,453th volume of the [[Royal Archives of Naboo]].

Lesia deemed her great-grandfather "old-fashioned" due to his [[Anti-droid sentiment/Legends|anti-droid sentiment]] and boycott of products manufactured by [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] or from corporations that aided both sides of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], such as [[Tagge Company/Legends|Tagge Company]] and the ones based on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]], writer of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', eventually cut any mentioning of Lesia in the final product. The character was later made [[canon]]ical in the [[StarWars.com]] blog post [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'': Author's Cut, Part 6 — Showdown at Naboo'']]. For Varqom's story, Fry took inspiration from [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]] veterans he knew who swore to never buy cars made in [[Wikipedia:Japan|Japan]] after the conflict.
